narrative: On the part. A fair roll in Garnish's hand, held down on the cold stage by a lead. Nine short speeches are in your hand above his copy-marks. Two are struck through. No one else is on the stage yet.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Checked the fair hand against the two cuts.

entities.name: Abel Garnish
entities.context: Had recopied the roll, and marked it so.

entities.name: Kemp's roll
entities.context: Shown on part in Into the book
